publication_rules: Review YES does not itself establish award team placement or exact college player ID

Preserve all 259 NO decisions as unapproved; individual NO list must be recovered from prior review source
Do not mistake the 2020 special-team review for a regular-postseason All-Conference award
notes: Recovered 55 named YES selections from original season-by-season review summaries, which were previously not recorded in the repository.
11 Mountain West profile award rows are already in all_conference_verified_links_2026_11_05.json; this ledger does not duplicate them.
Additional YES names need complete original source review before live publication.
